propositions: During autodeploy quiescence, the ~2-min no-op early exit at line 228 does not reclaim docker garbage, allowing root disk pressure to accumulate and trigger CloudWatch alarms even when no deploy is running.

The existing prune_docker_caches() function is defined after the line-228 no-op exit, making it impossible to call from that early-exit point without relocating the function definition to precede its first use.

A pressure-triggered, throttled reclaim mechanism on the no-op path fires every ~2 min when disk usage exceeds DISK_PRESSURE_PCT (default 80%) and at least PRESSURE_PRUNE_MIN_INTERVAL (default 600s) has elapsed since the last pressure prune.
Docker prune failures on the pressure path must remain non-fatal, logging only and preserving autodeploy's zero exit status to match deploy-path behavior.
